description: Electric ferries and buses in fictional Harbor City, over two rounds, with feedback after the first: relevant stories, a lightly weighted fare dimension, distractors, a blocked domain, a syndicated copy, a page whose only quote is invented, then an update, a reworded repeat, and a page seen before.

topic.name: Harbor City electric ferries and buses
topic.brief: Follow Harbor City's plans to electrify its ferry fleet and bus routes: vessel and bus purchases, charging infrastructure, budgets, schedules, and service changes riders will notice.

dimensions.name: Ferries
dimensions.description: Electric ferry purchases, deliveries, and service.

feedback.reason: Route changes are what I need to plan around.

probes.note: A syndicated copy in the same run is one story.
After the reader liked a bus route story and disliked a fare story, bus charging ranks above a fare proposal.
